title: Loyalty points aggregator
summary: Combine all your loyalty programs and points in one place.
whyTempting: People have dozens of loyalty programs and forget their points.
whyItFails: Programs block access. Loyalty schemes don't want aggregation. Low engagement. Users check rarely. Programs own the economics. Little room for a middleman.
whatWouldChange: Programs opening APIs for points exchange; still unlikely.

attempts.outcome: Shut down after running out of money

attempts.notes: Lets members buy, transfer and exchange loyalty currency for nearly 60 programs; acquired for US$385 million. Works with the programs rather than around them.

reasons.detail: Programs block access: Loyalty schemes don't want aggregation.
Programs own the economics: Little room for a middleman.
